confusion_boundaries: Association and bundle selection never activate an associated profile without independent requester evidence. This associated-profile activation guard does not waive the adopted bundle parent's own listed components or parent-owned effects.

When this bundle itself is adopted, apply all fifteen listed parent components together with their declared carriers and all eight parent-owned property effects; preserve the neck-or-wrist opening alternative within its component. Optional dependency selections may additionally activate only independently requested complete child/profile content and effects; unselected optional dependencies add no conditions, effects or adoption.

amendments.reassessment_rationale: The earlier review conflated optional dependency activation with optionality of the parent body. Each of the fifteen parent components has minimum_realizations=1 and the parent explicitly owns eight property effects. No parent-level OR or zero-component realization is stated. Optional adoption is the decision whether to adopt the bundle; independent_request_evidence_only governs associated-profile activation. The local neck-or-wrist opening OR remains unchanged and is not converted into a compulsory neck-and-wrist conjunction. Retain actual visual_bundle/base rather than inventing five exclusive branches or emptying parent effects.
amendments.previous_uncertainty_disposition: Resolved by distinguishing optional parent adoption, mandatory adopted-parent conjunction, local OR and independently selected optional dependencies. The previous review scope interpretation was incorrect; the source own components/effects were not optionalized.

decision.meaning_summary: The optional-to-adopt bundle, once adopted, jointly requires its fifteen parent components: same-wearer shirt/tie/knit/robe layering, attached contrasting folded hood, bounded diagonal two-color tie, independently colored knit-edge trim, and a smaller chest-panel emblem. Its eight parent effects remain owned by the parent. Optional member/profile activation is independently requested and does not waive the parent's own conjunction.
